race.title: Boat At Erbistock Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: AIR APPARENT appeals as a potentially useful sort in this sphere and he's hard to oppose able to race unpenalised for last week's Carlisle success. Kartoon And Co showed plenty to work on despite a near 3-year absence on his chase debut and can improve on that effort, with Ffos Las winner Gustapof completing the shortlist. AIR APPARENT (IRE) KARTOON AND CO (FR) GUSTAPOF (FR)
